text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Elevated 5xx error rate detected for /v1/generate (hosted, model-x) in us-west-2. Error rate ~3.2% over last 5m. Severity: Sev2. Alert: https://alerts.internal/redwood/ALRT-7890

ria: Oncall Ria here, picking this up. Looking at live logs and the frontend 5xx traces. Repro is consistent for longer-context requests (>2048 tokens).

omar: Noted customer impact: two customers reported API errors in support tickets (CS-4521, CS-4522). Informing CS to add interim note.

cheng: Quick check — model-x compile change deployed in last deploy window (ops-bot: deploy 2026-03-15T02:34Z -> model-x v3.2.1). Could be kernel selection change. Pulling deploy diff now.

ops-bot: Deploy event: model-x v3.2.1 rollout started 2026-03-15T02:34Z -> completed us-west-2. Links: https://deploys.internal/deploys/6789

ria: Mitigation plan: 1) Shift traffic away from us-west-2 -> us-west-1 for matched customers, 2) Pin to model-x v3.2.0 (rollback) on us-west-2, 3) Shorten accepted max_context to 2048 at routing layer to reduce OOM risk. Doing step 1 now.

cheng: I see elevated OOMs on the gpu nodes tied to kv cache growth after the new kernel. Logs: ```
2026-03-15T02:36:12Z gpu0 OOM: attempted alloc 512MB
2026-03-15T02:36:12Z renderer: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = runtime: out of memory
```

ria: Step 1 done: rerouted 60% of traffic to us-west-1 for affected orgs. Error rate in us-west-2 dropped to 1.1% but still elevated. Rolling back model v3.2.1 -> v3.2.0 on remaining hosts now.

katie: FYI — adding canned note to status.redwood.com so external-facing customers know we saw degraded errors and are mitigating. Suggest no full incident page unless SLA impact crosses threshold.

omar: CS updated customers CC'ing affected accounts. Requesting a short blurb for release notes once root cause confirmed.

ria: Rollback in progress. Monitoring.

ops-bot: Rollback action: model-x pinned to v3.2.0 in us-west-2 at 2026-03-15T02:48Z.

ria: After rollback, 5xx rate in us-west-2 is down to baseline (~0.05%). CPU/GPU mem stable. Looks like a compiler/kernel regression in v3.2.1.

cheng: Confirmed. Repro locally with long-context prompts and v3.2.1 kernel flags. Root cause: allocator path misbehavior with combined kv-cache + new attention kernel. Will open a detailed debugging ticket.

sylvia: Great work on mitigation. Let's schedule a postmortem and create action items: immediate remediation, test coverage, rollout gating, and Q2 tie-in for our Reliability OKR (reduce host-side OOM regressions). Can we meet tomorrow 10:00am PT? :calendar:

pm-evans: Tomorrow 10:00am PT works for PMs. We need to include SRE, runtime, and release engineering. Please add a facilitator.

ria: I can facilitate the postmortem. Creating a calendar invite and preliminary postmortem doc.

cheng: Action items draft (assignments + sizing):
- ACTION-1: Root cause writeup + repro & minimal test case. Owner: cheng. ETA: 1 business day. Size: M (4-8h).
- ACTION-2: Kernel rollback guard + deploy gating so kernel change can't roll without automated long-context test. Owner: katie. ETA: 2 sprints. Size: L (3-4d dev + CI).
- ACTION-3: KV-cache memory accounting + safeguards (eviction threshold per model). Owner: ria. ETA: 1 sprint. Size: M (2-3d).
- ACTION-4: Customer communication follow-up & release notes. Owner: omar. ETA: EOD. Size: S (1-2h).
- ACTION-5: Add synthetic long-context smoke to pre-prod canaries. Owner: ops (eng-infra). ETA: 2 weeks. Size: L.

omar: I'll create corresponding tickets (RED-8342, RED-8343, RED-8344) and link in postmortem doc.

sylvia: Prioritization notes: ACTION-1 & ACTION-3 = P0 for next sprint. ACTION-2 and ACTION-5 tie into Q2 Reliability OKR (reduce production regressions for model serving) — propose we allocate 20% of runtime squad sprint carry to these. ACTION-4 is P2 (communication).

katie: For sizing, propose we break ACTION-2 into: a) gating infra + CI job (2d), b) release docs + checklist (1d). I'll spin up tickets with sub-tasks.

ria: Postmortem scheduling: Tentative doc: https://docs.internal/postmortems/RED-8342-pm. Postmortem meeting: 2026-03-16 17:00Z (tomorrow 10:00am PT). Invite sent to SRE/runtime/release/pm/cs.

incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigation successful). Duration: 14m. Severity: Sev2 -> downgraded to Post-Incident Review. Link: https://incidents.internal/2198765432

pm-evans: Please add acceptance criteria for ACTION-3 (KV accounting): no unbounded growth on 99th percentile with synthetic 4k token load in canary; include rollback steps. That will help us verify before closing.

cheng: Noted. I'll include reproducible script + perf numbers in the ticket.

ria: Final ask before postmortem: anyone see customer-facing regressions we missed? If not, I'll update status page and mark incident as mitigated. :white_check_mark:

omar: CS confirms no new reports. Closing loop with affected customers and scheduling followup meetings for any escalation.

sylvia: Thanks all — we'll use this for sprint planning and Q2 reliability tie-ins. See you at the postmortem. :v:
